name: engineering-assessment
description: Artificial loan application system for MNZL engineering assessment.

scripts.setup: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile=false && pnpm db:generate && pnpm db:reset
scripts.dev: cross-env DATABASE_URL=file:./dev.db concurrently --kill-others --names api,web,worker --prefix-colors yellow,green,magenta "pnpm --filter @assessment/api dev" "pnpm --filter @assessment/web dev" "pnpm --filter @assessment/worker dev"
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.test: pnpm db:test:reset && cross-env DATABASE_URL=file:./test.db vitest run --no-file-parallelism
scripts.db:reset: node -e "require('node:fs').closeSync(require('node:fs').openSync('packages/database/prisma/dev.db', 'a'))" && cross-env DATABASE_URL=file:./dev.db prisma db push --schema packages/database/prisma/schema.prisma --accept-data-loss && cross-env DATABASE_URL=file:./dev.db tsx packages/database/prisma/seed.ts
scripts.db:test:reset: node -e "require('node:fs').closeSync(require('node:fs').openSync('packages/database/prisma/test.db', 'a'))" && cross-env DATABASE_URL=file:./test.db prisma db push --schema packages/database/prisma/schema.prisma --accept-data-loss --skip-generate
